paragraph: At a Wisconsin prison, men who could not join sports found another way to move. They began raising monarch butterflies, feeding caterpillars and watching wings dry in the sun. The program started at Redgranite Correctional Institute after the organizer sought something gentle for those with physical limits. Now inmates tend the insects through every stage, from egg to orange-winged flight. When the butterflies rise above the prison fence, some of the men look up and grin.

seed.summary: Wisconsin prison inmates have been offered a unique way to give back to their community by raising monarch butterflies from the inside. Set up at Redgranite Correctional Institute (RGCI), the idea first came to the program organizer while looking for something that inmates who were physically unable to participate in sports could do.
